name: Tsukiishi Ruu
source:
"The moment I met you I felt it... that thing called fate."

Star Sign: Leo
An idol at the peak of his popularity.

His singing has a mysterious power to melt the hearts of all women like candy.
He lives in the same town as Lapis and meets her by chance.
Skillful and proud, he has a natural idol disposition.
